meta.overview_description: Live performance benchmarks for virtual list libraries. Compare render time, memory usage, scroll FPS, and P95 frame time across React, Vue, SolidJS, Svelte, and Vanilla JS implementations.
meta.library_description: Live performance benchmark for {name}. Measure render time, memory usage, scroll FPS, and P95 frame time with {npm} in your browser.
meta.compare_description: Compare virtual list libraries head-to-head in your browser. Run any combination of React, Vue, SolidJS, Svelte, and Vanilla JS implementations under identical test conditions.
meta.results_description: Aggregated benchmark results from real users across devices and browsers. See how virtual list libraries compare based on crowdsourced data — render time, memory, scroll FPS, and P95 frame time.

overview.title: Benchmarks
overview.desc: Live performance benchmarks for {count} virtual list libraries. Each benchmark runs in your browser with identical test conditions — same DOM structure, same scroll patterns, same measurement pipeline. Select a library to begin.
overview.methodology_desc: All benchmarks follow identical methodology. Execution order is randomized per run to eliminate GC bleed and JIT warmth bias. GC barriers are placed between runs. All libraries render the same 7-element DOM template per item.

results.title: Crowdsourced Results
results.desc: Aggregated benchmark data from real users across different hardware, browsers, and conditions. Every run contributes to the dataset — no single machine bias.
results.empty: No benchmark data yet. Run some benchmarks to start building the dataset!
results.empty_filter: No data for this combination of items and stress level.
results.footer_note: Medians from crowdsourced runs. Actual performance depends on your hardware, browser, and system load.
